comment: The pdp_auth_type=none runs reach Cerbos through the authzen-auth-proxy pass-through port 9446, which checks no credentials, and Cerbos does not authenticate the PEP; Section 11.2 says the PDP SHOULD authenticate the calling PEP

Cerbos PDP bug: it merges an evaluation's subject with the top-level default instead of replacing it, so alice inherits the default's role admin and is permitted, where Section 7.1.1 says the evaluation's key overrides the default and certification scenario 6.2.7 says there is no sub-field merging

Cerbos PDP bug: it answers a batch in which an evaluation does not resolve to a complete subject, action and resource with HTTP 200 and decision false for that evaluation, where the request is malformed and the PDP MUST return HTTP 400 (Sections 7.1.1 and 10.1.1, openid/authzen#763)

Cerbos PDP behavior: its metadata advertises urn:authzen:pdp:* capabilities; authzen is not a registered URN namespace, and Section 12.4 registers the urn:ietf:params:authzen sub-namespace for capabilities

Cerbos PDP behavior: its metadata advertises urn:authzen:pdp:* capabilities; authzen is not a registered URN namespace, and Section 12.4 registers the urn:ietf:params:authzen sub-namespace for capabilities
Cerbos PDP behavior: it returns the next page when a page token arrives with a changed page.limit, where Section 8.2 says the PDP SHOULD return an error

Cerbos PDP behavior: it returns the next page when a page token arrives with a changed subject, resource or action, where Section 8.2 says the PDP SHOULD return an error when any entity or parameter has been changed

Cerbos PDP behavior: it answers GET and PUT on the AuthZEN endpoints with 404, the fallback the AuthZEN working group accepts when a framework routes on method and path; 405 with Allow: POST is preferred

Cerbos PDP behavior: its searches return entities its own Access Evaluation API denies (bob among the users who can write record-1, record-1 among the records bob can write, write among bob's actions on record-1, though bob writing record-1 is denied), where Section 8.1 says each search result SHOULD evaluate to true
